nodes.author: DanielOlimac
nodes.text:
To clarify:

Is the virus real? I guess.
Is anyone in China panicking, are people dying en masse and hospitals flooded with people? NO!

Does anyone here care? Not really. 

I'm not a virologist btw. But what I know is, pretty much nothing much is happening.

nodes.author: DanielOlimac
nodes.text:
And look, this is not me saying I blindly trust whatever the CCP says to its People. 

Yeah, it's winter...people get sick as usual. Is there any major excess deaths to account for? If there is, let's sound the alarms. Until then, stop the fearmongering, please.
